title: Semantic context resolves repository instructions
userIntent: Resolve source context together with the applicable root-to-nearest AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md guidance without treating guidance as semantic scope authority.

intendedBehavior: Selected source paths include applicable root-to-nearest AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md guidance.
Sibling guidance does not leak into unrelated targets.
Instruction files remain guidance-only evidence and do not consume the exact source file budget.
behavioralInvariants: Guidance resolution follows bounded directory ancestry.
Missing optional guidance is normal; denied or unreadable guidance remains a visible coverage gap.
Context precision and source budgets remain independent from instruction guidance.
regressionRisks: Dropping AGENTS/CLAUDE guidance from exact-path context.
Leaking sibling guidance across target paths.
Promoting guidance files into lifecycle or semantic authority.

provenance.note: Final exact-main convergence acceptance scenario added by Plan S4; the immutable snapshot is the S3-integrated main revision.
